P2: The grounds where the 阿露福遗迹 are located can be reached from 32号道路 to the east and 36号道路 to the north. There are four interior chambers. Each chamber holds a puzzle in which tiles must be arranged to show the image of a specific Pokémon species. Completing each puzzle causes a series of 未知图腾 forms to begin appearing in the large hall beneath the complex. The mysterious Pokémon species appears in many different forms that all resemble letters of the alphabet. Unown's encounter rate is evenly divided among all unlocked forms.
P3: Each chamber also features a message in Unown script on the rear wall. Deciphering this message and using the correct item or field move reveals a doorway to hidden room filled with items.
M1: After clearing at least one puzzle
M2: 100%（divided equally among all forms whose puzzles have been solved）
M3: After obtaining all 26 alphabetic Unown forms, completing all 4 tile puzzles, and unlocking all 4 secret rooms

P4:
The north chamber is the only one accessible at first. Examine the text on the rear wall to find a single word: ESCAPE. Using an 离洞绳 here reveals a hidden doorway. The room behind holds an 橙橙果, 桃桃果, 万能粉, and an EnergyPowder. Dropping down through the hole at the back wall leads to a hidden room above the underground hall, where a message in Unown script can be found on the floor:
OUR CLAN ENGRAVED WORDS IN THIS PLACE
Our clan engraved words in this place
P5: In the entry room, a bit of text beside the puzzle hints at the Pokémon's identity. Move the tiles to their proper place to reveal the Pokémon's image and complete the puzzle. Doing so causes the floor to fall away, dropping you into the underground hall where the first ten forms of 未知图腾 have awakened. This draws the attention of a researcher, who notices your talent for archaeology and gives you the 未知图腾笔记. This device records the limited data available on each of the Unown forms.
C5: This Pokémon hides on the seafloor and watches the shore with eyes on its back.
C7: This Pokémon knew no fear and flew as it pleased through the skies long ago.
C9: This Pokémon, with feathers of seven colors, flies through the sky, according to legend.
C11: A ten-legged Pokémon that swims on the bottom of the sea and eats plankton.
P6:
The southeast chamber can be accessed after obtaining 秘传学习器03（冲浪）. Examine the text on the rear wall to find a single word: LIGHT. Using the move 闪光 here will reveal another hidden doorway. The room behind holds a 文柚果, 月之石, 万能粉, and an 元气根. Dropping down through the hole at the back wall leads to a second hidden room above the underground hall, where another message in Unown script can be found on the floor:
OUR CLAN CREATED POKEMON STATUE OUTSIDE
Our clan created Pokémon statue outside
P7: In the entry room, move the tiles to reveal an image of 化石翼龙, and the floor falls away. Completing this puzzle causes five more 未知图腾 forms to appear in the underground hall.
P8:
The western chamber can only be accessed through 互连洞, after obtaining 秘传学习器03（冲浪）. Examine the text on the rear wall to find a single word: HO OH. Positioning a 凤王 in the first party slot will reveal another hidden doorway. The room behind holds a 生命宝珠, 苹野果, 复活草, and a 木炭. Dropping down through the hole at the back wall leads to a third hidden room above the underground hall, where another message in Unown script can be found on the floor:
WE HUMANS NEED TO WALK WITH THEM
We humans need to walk with them
WE LEAVE HERE FOR THE SAKE OF THEM
We leave here for the sake of them
P9: In the entry room, move the tiles to reveal an image of 凤王, and the floor falls away. Completing this puzzle causes four more 未知图腾 forms to appear.
P10:
The southwest chamber can only be accessed through 互连洞, after obtaining 秘传学习器03（冲浪） and 秘传学习器04（怪力）. Examine the text on the rear wall to find a single word: WATER. Attempting to use a 水之石 here will reveal another hidden doorway. The room behind holds a 苹野果, 神秘水滴, 星星沙子, and a 星星碎片. Dropping down through the hole at the back wall leads to another hidden room above the underground hall, where a final message in Unown script can be found on the floor:
THEY POSSESS POWER TO SENSE WITH MIND AND REJECT OUTSIDE
They possess power to sense with mind and reject outside
P11: In the entry room, move the tiles to reveal an image of 菊石兽, and the floor falls away. Completing this puzzle causes the final seven 未知图腾 forms to appear.
P12: As you approach the southern end of the route, you see a shady man loitering around to the west of the Pokémon Center. If spoken to, he tries to sell you a "tasty, nutritious SlowpokeTail" for the special price of ₽1,000,000. When he realizes that you do not have the cash, he shooes you away.
P13: Visit the Pokémon Center to rest your weary team and prepare for the upcoming cave. Speak to the Fisherman near the counter to receive an 破旧钓竿. With this fishing rod, you can now cast your line at any body of water to reel in 水 Pokémon. The Old Rod is a low-end model, and is often only able to hook 鲤鱼王.
P14: 互连洞 is a small cave on the southern end of Johto's peninsula, located between Routes 32号道路 and 33号道路. The ground-level tunnel simply connects the two routes together. Seawater wells up from underground in several areas, initially blocking access to the deepest parts of the cave. Exploring the lower levels at a later point reveals two more exits that lead back to the 阿露福遗迹.

P16: Go north to reach an X Defend, then pick up 招式学习器39（岩石封锁） in the southwest corner. The rest of the area cannot be explored without using 冲浪, so backtrack up the stairs to 1F.
X2: Requires: 秘传学习器03（冲浪）, 秘传学习器04（怪力）
X3: Return later and use 冲浪 to cross the water and reach two branching paths. The northern tunnel leads to the western part of the 阿露福遗迹, which houses the third puzzle and the area's only patch of tall grass. The southern tunnel is blocked by a boulder; using 怪力 to clear a path leads to the fourth puzzle in the southwest part of the ruins.
P17: Go south to battle Hiker Daniel, then move southeastward to fight Hiker Russell. Turn south to reach Firebreather Bill; defeat him and collect the 超级球 in the corner to the south. Go west to pick up a 伤药, then continue southward. Battle Poké Maniac Larry, then turn southeastward to reach an 解眠药 near the exit.
X6: Return later and use 冲浪 to cross the pool of water in the southwest area.
X8: Battle Poké Maniac Andrew and 冲浪 eastward. Climb down the ladder next to Poké Maniac Calvin.
X10: Cross the water to reach an ＰＰ多项小补剂 in the northeast area. Sail southward to reach Ace Trainer Nick and a 厉害伤药 on the east-central ridge. Go northwestward across the water to battle Ace Trainer Gwen, then head south to fight Ace Trainer Emma. On Fridays, a wild 拉普拉斯 wanders its way in from the sea and appears in the southern-most pool.
